landscapingNote: Fields, parks, and lawn polygons use OpenStreetMap geometry. Green park fills are a simplified landscape treatment, not a surveyed grass-only inventory. Hedge accents along Trousdale Parkway are illustrative. No satellite imagery is bundled or traced.
extractionNote: All mapped footways, paths, steps, pedestrian and cycle routes intersecting the two campus areas are retained, including unnamed ways. Boundary streets and the Village border streets are retained within the campus frame. Footway display should be clipped to the campus areas.
